author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
The problem of education is for a long time, it starts teaching students on how to do something. Then let the students figure out why it should be done this way and when they should use A instead of B themselves.

With AI, you don't really have to know the how. You still have to understand the why, the when to use and what to use questions.

The real question is, can we know why and what, without knowing how?
